name: Botox for Forehead Lines
description: Reduce forehead lines and wrinkles with precision Botox injections. Natural-looking results that last 3-4 months.
longDescription: Botox (botulinum toxin) temporarily relaxes facial muscles to smooth out dynamic wrinkles. Our experienced injectors use precise techniques to maintain natural facial expressions while reducing visible lines.

name: Botox for Crow's Feet
description: Smooth out crow's feet and laugh lines around the eyes for a refreshed, youthful appearance.
longDescription: Crow's feet are dynamic wrinkles that form from repeated facial expressions. Botox injections target these specific muscles to soften lines while preserving your natural smile.

name: Dermal Fillers - Lip Enhancement
description: Add volume, shape, and definition to lips with hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers.
longDescription: Our lip enhancement treatments use premium hyaluronic acid fillers to create natural-looking volume and definition. Customized to your desired look, from subtle to dramatic.

name: Erectile Dysfunction Treatment
description: Effective treatments for erectile dysfunction including Viagra, Cialis, and generic alternatives.
longDescription: Our doctors review your medical history and prescribe appropriate ED medications. Choose from various options with different duration and onset times.

name: Hair Loss Treatment
description: Clinically proven treatments for male pattern baldness including Finasteride and Minoxidil.
longDescription: Combat hair loss with FDA-approved medications. Our doctors create personalized treatment plans based on your hair loss pattern and medical history.

name: Contraceptive Pill
description: Convenient access to various contraceptive pills prescribed by our doctors.
longDescription: Get your contraceptive pill prescription online and delivered to your door. Choose from various brands and formulations to find what works best for you.

name: Morning After Pill
description: Emergency contraception available with fast consultation and express 2-hour delivery in select cities.
longDescription: Quick access to emergency contraception when you need it. Our doctors provide rapid consultations and we offer express delivery options.

name: High Blood Pressure Management
description: Ongoing management and medication for high blood pressure with regular doctor monitoring.
longDescription: Our doctors provide comprehensive blood pressure management including medication, lifestyle advice, and regular monitoring to keep your BP in healthy ranges.

name: Quit Smoking Program
description: Comprehensive smoking cessation program with medication support and coaching.
longDescription: Evidence-based smoking cessation program combining medication (Champix/Zyban) with behavioral support to help you quit for good.

name: Malaria Prevention
description: Antimalarial medication prescribed based on your travel destination and duration.
longDescription: Get the right malaria prevention for your trip. Our doctors prescribe appropriate antimalarial medication based on your destination, duration, and medical history.
